admins.onekey: Warning: only one key can sign for this company. If it is lost, no computer accepts anything new: add a second key or administrator.
admins.signed: Admin list %d of %s is signed and with the server. Computers take it the next time they contact it.
admins.typekey: Type the key's whole fingerprint, as its owner reads it to you from their wmanager-sign (32 characters):
admins.yourname: Your name, as computers will show it:
audit.broken: WARNING: the server's audit log of %s no longer leads to entry %d, the newest you saw (%s). It was changed, or restored from an older backup: check the server, and its heads in Loki.

audit.gap: entry %d is missing or out of place
chain.another: the server now gives this company's id to another chain, of fingerprint %s
chain.bad: The server's admin lists of %s don't check: %s. Nothing was signed.
chain.forked: ALARM: the server's chain of admin lists of %s leaves the one you hold (%s). It could bring back a key removed since: the server may be hacked. Nothing was signed; tell the other administrators.
chain.new: New admin list %d, signed by %s on %s:
chain.older: The server has %[2]d admin lists of %[1]s, you hold %[3]d: it is behind (a backup restored?). Yours stay.
chain.pushed: Gave the server the admin lists it lacked (%d).
chain.pushfailed: The server didn't take the lists it lacks: %s
company.heldalready: You hold the chain of %s already (fingerprint %s).
company.made:
%s is set up. Its fingerprint:

    %s

Write it down and keep it. Computers are checked against it when they are installed, and other administrators type it in (wmanager-sign company trust). The panel shows it too, but a hacked server could show another one there.
company.newid: The server lists %s under another id than before; its chain is the one you hold.
company.notsent: The server's answer didn't come (%s). The list is kept here, and wmanager-sign gives it to the server the next time it runs.
company.refused: The server refused the list: the fingerprint above is no company's. Forget it.
company.renamed: You took this company as %s; the server now calls it %s.
company.trusted: The chain of %s checks against the fingerprint, and is kept.
company.typefp: Type the company's fingerprint, as it was written down or as an administrator reads it to you (32 characters):
connect.code: The code from the panel (page Account, Connect wmanager-sign):
disconnect.done: The connection to %s is forgotten here. To end it on the server too, use "Disconnect wmanager-sign everywhere" on the panel's page Account.
err.badcode: The server refused the code: it is wrong, used already, or older than 5 minutes. Make a new one on the panel's page Account.
err.baddraft: The draft isn't one wmanager-sign reads: %s
err.badkey: The security key gave a key wmanager-sign can't use: %s
err.badlist: The new admin list isn't valid: %s
err.badserver: The server's address is https://host or https://host:port, with nothing after it.
err.choice: That is not one of the numbers.
err.clock: Your clock is %s off the server's (%s): wmanager-sign signs only within 10 minutes of it. Set the clock right.
err.drafttype: wmanager-sign doesn't sign a draft of the type %s.
err.emptygroup: No computer of the state verified here is in the group %s: nothing was signed.
err.fpmismatch: The server's chain of %s doesn't match the fingerprint you typed. Check it with an administrator: if it is right, the server shows another chain. Nothing was kept.
err.haschain: %s has an admin list already: take it with wmanager-sign company trust.
err.idmismatch: That is not the start of the id of %s: nothing was signed. Check the id the installer showed.
err.keyconflict: The server didn't take the key: %s
err.keyinlist: That key is in the list already (%s).
err.lastadmin: That is the only administrator: a list needs at least one.
err.lastkey: That is the only key of %s: remove the administrator instead, or add another key first.
err.nochainyet: %s has no admin list yet: its first administrator makes it with wmanager-sign company init.
err.nojob: No job %s is signed for this company: nothing was signed.
err.nokeyfp: No key with that fingerprint is registered by a member of this company. Has its owner made it on this server (wmanager-sign key new), and are they a member?
err.nokeyhere: This security key holds no key that may sign this.
err.nokeys: You have no signing key made here: make one with wmanager-sign key new.
err.nopublicurl: The server can't register keys until its address is set (WMANAGER_PUBLIC_URL).
err.noscript: The script couldn't be fetched: %s. Nothing was signed.
err.nosecret: The secret %s isn't in the state verified here, so the computers don't have it: nothing was signed.
err.noserver: Not connected to a server: run wmanager-sign connect https://your-server
err.nostate: No state of %s is verified here yet: sign or take its first state before jobs and secrets.
err.notadmin: You are not an administrator of %s.
err.notinjob: The draft stops the job on a computer it doesn't run on (%s): nothing was signed.
err.notinstate: The draft names a computer that isn't in the state verified here (%s): nothing was signed.
err.notlisted: The server doesn't list %s among your companies under the id it gave it before. Run wmanager-sign to see the companies it lists, or give the company's id.
err.notoken: The connection to %[1]s has ended: make a code on the panel's page Account, then run wmanager-sign connect %[1]s
err.nouv: The security key made the key without checking your PIN or fingerprint and your touch: it can't be used.
err.reportednewer: The computers report state %d, newer than any known here (%d): the server doesn't show it, so the next state can't be shown against what the computers have. Nothing was signed. The administrator who signed it gives it to the server again by running wmanager-sign.
err.scriptnottext: The script isn't text: nothing was signed.
err.secretmismatch: The two values of %s differ, or are empty: nothing was signed.
err.synced: That is a synced passkey (backup eligible): a signing key must stay on one security key. Use a security key, not a phone or a password manager.
err.tokenended: The connection to %[1]s has ended: make a code on the panel's page Account, then run wmanager-sign connect %[1]s
err.toomany: Too many wrong codes: wait a minute and try again.
err.twocompanies: Several of your companies are called %s: give the company's id.
err.unshown: Not every file could be shown, so nothing was signed.
err.untrusted: You don't hold the chain of %s yet: take it with wmanager-sign company trust %s (or, for a new company, company init).
err.validfor: A job is valid from 1 second to 7 days after signing: nothing was signed.
job.assystem: Runs as SYSTEM: everything on these computers.
job.groups: from the groups %s, as the state verified here has them

key.made:
Your new signing key is registered. Its fingerprint:

    %s

An administrator adds it to a company by typing these 32 characters. Read them out in person or by phone, not through the panel or an e-mail.
key.none: No signing key was made here.
key.touchnew: Touch the security key to make the new signing key.
sign.nodrafts: Nothing of %s is waiting to be signed.
sign.which: Which one to show and sign (1-%d)?
state.alsofrom: What it changes for the computers that have %s:
state.bad: The server's newest state of %s doesn't check: %s. It isn't kept.
state.behind: The server's newest state of %s is %d, you hold %d: it is behind (a backup restored?). Yours stays.
state.binary: (not text, %d bytes): it can't be shown, so it isn't signed. Such files come only with wmanager-sign add-file, from your own disk.
state.farabove: its serial %d, signed by %s, whose key was removed since, is far above any known here, and isn't counted
state.first: The first state: everything in it is new.
state.forked: ALARM: the server now shows another state of %s with the serial %d than the one it handed out before. The server may be hacked; nothing was signed.
state.lacking: The server lacks the value of the secret %s: type it again.
state.minevsother: The state %[2]d of %[1]s signed here never reached the server, or it refused it; it has one signed by %[3]s with that serial. Both may be on computers: the next state is shown against both.
state.newline: (the line break at the end changes)
state.noold: (the old content isn't on the server any more: the new one whole)
state.notours: not a state of this company
state.oldkey: The server's newest state of %s, %d, is signed by %s, whose key is no longer in the admin list. The computers that took it before the newer list have it: the next state is shown against it too, and has a higher serial.
state.otherformer: state %d, signed by %s, removed since: the computers that took it before the newer admin list have it
state.othermine: state %d signed here, which the server doesn't have (it refused it, or its answer was lost): computers may have it
state.pushed: Gave the server the newest state known here (%d).
state.pushfailed: The server didn't take the newest state known here: %s
state.release: The release certificate the computers accept changes to the one of hash %s.
state.secretvalue: The value of the secret %s (not shown):
state.server: The computers will contact the server %s.
state.signed: State %d of %s is signed and with the server. Computers take it the next time they contact it.
state.typeid: %s is a new computer: type the first 8 characters of its id, as its installer showed them:
state.unchecked: wmanager-sign doesn't check the release certificate and wmanager's version against the signed releases yet (stage 6): sign this change only if you expect it.

status.nochain: %s (%s): no admin list yet (wmanager-sign company init)
status.nocompanies: Your account is in no company yet.
status.reported: the computers report state %d, which the server doesn't show

usage:
wmanager-sign signs what the computers of your companies act on, with your security key.

  wmanager-sign connect https://server   connect with a code from the panel (page Account)
  wmanager-sign                          your companies, and the admin lists new since you looked
  wmanager-sign key new                  make a signing key on the security key, and register it
  wmanager-sign key list                 the signing keys made here
  wmanager-sign company init <company>   make a new company's first admin list
  wmanager-sign company trust <company>  take a company's chain, against its fingerprint
  wmanager-sign fingerprint <company>    the company's fingerprint
  wmanager-sign admins <company>         the company's administrators
  wmanager-sign admins add|add-key|remove-key|remove <company>
                                         sign the next admin list
  wmanager-sign sign <company>           show and sign what waits: a state, a job, a stop
  wmanager-sign secret set <company> <name>
                                         a secret's new value, typed, in the next state
  wmanager-sign disconnect               forget the connection here

Options before the command: -server https://server, -lang en|de|fr|es|it|pl|nl|pt|ro|cs.
The folder it keeps its data in: $WMANAGER_SIGN_HOME, or wmanager-sign in your configuration folder.
